program_layout: 22 doubles: mode(0normal,1missing,2reset,3schedule), missing_start/end, reset_start/end, schedule_count, reserved0, then five(time_s,jitter_s,interference_s) triples. Select schedule by the latest actual JEOS reference, never future plant samples.
missing: Observer-consumer ingress loss only; physical ADC/controller continue. Suppress exactly five observer captures. Do not read dropped measurement/ADC values into estimation; advance only deterministic bias-model state, clear derivative history. Do not anchor the voltage predictor with unavailable current; retain causal model propagation and voltage filter memory.
known_stream_restart: At declared loss/reset onset, clear pending/old packet cache, increment explicit stream epoch and latch permission off. Missing sequence jumps are accepted only as the first packet of this declared new stream. Unknown duplicate/gap/timestamp faults keep original R0 rejection and an additional integrity latch, cleared only by explicit reset.
reset: Software observer reset for one50us control interval starting at the specified JEOS. Physical frontend continues; deterministic bias/frontend-voltage memory is retained, SMO/EMF/PLL/quality and current derivative history reset. A separate live reset input vetoes the queue on the first native call; never wait3us for reset quality. Not a whole-board power cycle.
timing: Preserve controller/PI math. Replace only the local physical PWM actor for the timing case. Capture job reference/budget at JEOS; consume request at actual write as the existing actor does. UEV precedes a tied write. Actual observer publication is JEOS+3us+jitter; write is JEOS+8us+jitter+interference. The specified maximum38us remains below the50us task period: this covers PWM-update/deadline crossing, NOT actual interrupt-job overlap; reject unsupported overlap instead of overwriting jobs.
logging: Add actual accepted-publication event log at native completion, including variable jitter and skipped frames. Preserve old publication display log but do not use its fixed sampling clock as evidence of actual completion. Record epoch, reset/missing, integrity, and current-anchor validity; mark missing measurement metadata unavailable with finite explicit flags.
component_tests: Nominal voltage/ingress/queue and PWM actor equal frozen local R1; arbitrary dropped data cannot affect ingress or anchors;5deg guard remains unchanged. Missing exactly5 captures, reset live veto, strict unknown-sequence latch, jitter no early publication, tied/late CCR-write independent timestamp oracles, unsupported overlap rejection.
physical_tests: Require pre-fault permission, immediate native veto at the declared fault JEOS, zero native permission/output violations, real missing/reset/timing triggers and publications, recovery only after599 good control samples and20ms contiguous good permission. Recovery must occur within150ms after the first healthy reference and beforeStopTime. Complete full native false-valid audit; parent control-precision limits apply whenever recovery is claimed.
failure_policy: One explicit native retry at most per case/version across labels; no numerical retry selection. Source/archive and incomplete/failed executions remain visible. No feedback takeover or measured-WCET claim.
